caption.instagram:
Southlake Health and Scarborough Health Network's nursing extern postings both close Monday, Nov 30. Southlake lists 40 positions; SHN's is a talent pool, not one specific vacancy. Neither publishes a closing time, so don't leave it to the last night.

Swipe for who each one is for, plus two more that are taking applications with no closing date listed.

I built a free tracker that checks every posting against the hospital's own page and shows which ones you meet the listed criteria for. Link in bio. Not affiliated with any hospital. Always confirm details on the posting.
